The '''Lees family''' was a family of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] that lived on a [[Lees farm|farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]]. [[Tayala Lees]], the leader of the [[Ayanee Farming Cluster]], was a member of the family.<ref name="Strongholds" />
